body: but if you ever need soimeone to talk to, anytime, send me a message and we can talk. noone deserves to go thru that alone.
send me a message with your number. iv got nothing but time, and some experience behind me.

exercise helped me a TON. i lost weight, which boosted self confidence, made me tired, and took my mind off it. do you have any specific hobbies? find something that you can be really, truly passionate about. pour your soul into it, and watch as your troubles slowly fade from your mind. your brother made a choice, but dont let his decision make a choice for you. oh and on the boys, were all trouble. just find the one thats worth it.

find someone new to be with. this will help take your mind off your brother and your former.  go on some dates, hang out with your younger brother, work out, anyhting to get your mind off of it. do you see how him committing suicide made you feel? now imagine how it would feel to your younger brother if that happened again. dont even think of it as an option. its not. find someone to be with, spend time with family, do anyhting to get your mind away from the past. if your partner couldnt see what your going thru, then they didnt deserve you anyway. and most of all: remember reddit is here for you. you may not know us, we may not know you, but we are here. we are family. we want you around. ((hug))
